source.sourceScope: Ignored clean diagnostic commit with the stated production parent and observer-only overlay; the main production checkout was not changed by this run.

native.backgroundScope: Stage intervals on traces without a captured request envelope, including startup or background work; nested stages overlap and are not caller or batch cardinality.

jit.backgroundScope: Stage intervals on traces without a captured request envelope, including startup or background work; nested stages overlap and are not caller or batch cardinality.

observationPolicy.stageScope: Inclusive wall intervals and wall outside direct captured children include I/O, scheduling and uncaptured code. Neither is CPU or scheduler-wait time. Nested stages and marginal percentile summaries must not be added or subtracted to infer causes.
observationPolicy.partitionScope: Inclusive server phase wall times and per-request disjoint interval partition; Npgsql client execution spans, not CPU/SQL statements/round trips. No efficacy or historical-regression claim. Warmups excluded. Marginal medians are not additive. Client clocks are never subtracted from server clocks.
observationPolicy.backgroundScope: Background intervals are retained separately and can overlap one another. They do not map one-to-one to waiting callers.
observationPolicy.runtimeSamplerScope: Whole-process numeric observations every 100 ms; ticks may coalesce. Zero observed queue does not establish absence of queue wait.
observationPolicy.comparisonScope: One fixed-order instrumented pair, 100 excluded warmups plus 1000 measured complete responses per workload. No efficacy, significance, historical recovery or causal attribution claim.

archivedLedgerAudit.reviewScope: Independent retained read-only archive calculation; no database restore, live queries or new requests.

preservedPretrafficMetadataCorrections.scope: Inherited inactive historical plan replaced with the current899/98 detailed32-stage, no-CPU plan before infrastructure, apps or traffic.
Inactive freeze lacked generated JIT write-identity candidates. Identities and freeze were corrected before authority, apps or traffic; actual observed identities and all joins remained mandatory.

sourcePreparationNote: Initial whitespace checks found CRLF in newly written observer source. All 28 staged files were normalized before the diagnostic commit, validation, builds and traffic; original checks were retained.
conclusion: All 32 stage summaries, including zero observations, and background ranges are retained. These wall-time observations guide further investigation; they do not demonstrate that the regression is resolved or identify its cause.
